changelog.text: Checked all networks. Centurion card guests now include family; Polaris partner list adds ITA and Brussels; Star Alliance Gold guests must be on your flight; Delta One Basic fares lose access Jan 19, 2027 (notice); updated guest rules for Admirals, Alaska and Flagship; fixed Sapphire, Delta One and SFO lounge locations, added the IAD Etihad/Sapphire lounge, marked the SFO Alaska Lounge closed.
Rules moved to a live data store. Items marked unverified will be checked on the first refresh.

needsAppUpdate: Delta One: from Jan 19, 2027, Delta One Basic fares lose lounge access; the app has no field to exclude a fare type for this network.
